title: Rolling Hills → Mountain Peaks (composition demo)
description: COMP-1 demo composition, hand-authored from two existing evolved kernels. Pass 1 renders "Rolling Hills" (shadertoy_evolved) into an offscreen buffer; pass 2 renders "Mountain Peaks" (shadertoy_evolved) to the screen with that buffer bound as iChannel0. Neither kernel was authored with channels in mind, so the screen pass doesn't yet sample iChannel0 in its own body — this proves the DAG-validated multi-pass pipeline end to end (target allocation, per-pass compile, channel binding) ahead of COMP-2/3's channel-consuming kernels.
